name: Mawangui Sinbu ~Yongsanimeun Mawangui Sinbu~
source:
When I woke up from my sleep in the subway,

"What?! I'm your legendary HERO?!
And... wait a minute!!!!
Are you telling me that... I have to marry a Demon Lord?!!?!"

Do I really have to marry these Demon Lords? How did I end up in this strange world?!

A story where you 'just happened' to marry a Demon Lord.
translation:
“当我在地铁里从睡梦中醒来时，

“什么？！我是你们的传奇英雄？！”
还有……等一下！！！！
你是说……我必须嫁给魔王吗？！！！”

难道我真的要嫁给这些魔王吗？我怎么会来到这个陌生的世界？！

一个你‘碰巧’嫁给了魔王的故事。
